interpretation.query_audit: All query forks preserve pre-query ingress/producer/composer recurrence. Held-publication contrasts isolate direct access to pre-query content, not historical information already absorbed into recurrent state.
interpretation.fresh_control: Separately trained current-candidate reads retain recurrent experts and matched sparse execution. This is not an otherwise-identical trained function.
interpretation.primary_causal_criterion: Normal-write initial-publication content shuffling versus intact, combined with exact-task advantage over trained fresh recurrence.
interpretation.held_diagnostics: Holding all publications also removes legitimate fast query-time computation; held contrasts are diagnostic rather than a required support criterion.
interpretation.old_mass: Full-query probability mass on publications older than 16 bytes; provenance, not a causal usefulness score.
interpretation.bootstrap: First four generic owner commits per stream are forced, excluded from learned gate credit and reported separately.
interpretation.time: Evaluation and audit wall times include their diagnostic forks; live execution counts exclude those extra forwards.

interventions.blocked: Reads zeroed from first through final query byte.
interventions.terminal_blocked: Only final query byte has reads zeroed; prefix stays intact.
interventions.hold: Writes held throughout query, leaving pre-query publications unchanged.
interventions.hold_blocked: Both held writes and blocked reads throughout query.
interventions.shuffle: Other-document payload/header replaces initial publication content; normal query writes continue.
interventions.aged_shuffle: Only existing pre-query cells strictly older than age_threshold receive valid other-document content; metadata is preserved and normal query writes continue.
interventions.hold_shuffle: Other-document payload/header with publications held throughout query.
interventions.fresh: Current producer candidates replace the publication read; age zero, no stored payload access.

audit.scope: All forks preserve pre-query ingress/producer/composer recurrence. Hold/shuffle branches retain the trained read control. Publication-hold contrasts isolate pre-query publication access only when live_control is intact; fresh uses current candidates and blocked disables contribution.
